Synopsis:
    JetBlue revises down its Q3 capacity growth forecast (1.5–3.5% vs. prior 3–6%) due to higher fuel costs driven by the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran, weather disruptions, and ATC issues in the U.S. Northeast. Fuel cost guidance raised sharply to $3.96/gallon from $3.49. Revenue per available seat mile outlook improved on strong demand and higher ticket pricing. Airline facing compounding pressures from aircraft groundings and heavy debt post-Spirit Airlines collapse.
